tables.name: recurring_schedule_details
tables.comment: 一覧の読み出しに使う、繰り返しの予定と訪問の情報と名前を結合したビュー
tables.def: CREATE VIEW recurring_schedule_details AS (select `rs`.`id` AS `id`,`rs`.`facility_id` AS `facility_id`,`rs`.`schedule_type_id` AS `schedule_type_id`,`st`.`name` AS `schedule_type_name`,`rs`.`date` AS `date`,`rs`.`start_time` AS `start_time`,`rs`.`end_time` AS `end_time`,`rs`.`is_over_time_work` AS `is_over_time_work`,`rs`.`staff_id` AS `staff_id`,`u`.`username` AS `staff_name`,`rs`.`title` AS `title`,`rs`.`description` AS `description`,`rs`.`recurring_rule_id` AS `recurring_rule_id`,`rr`.`frequency` AS `frequency`,`rr`.`day_of_week` AS `day_of_week`,`rr`.`day_of_month` AS `day_of_month`,`rr`.`week_of_month` AS `week_of_month`,`rr`.`end_date` AS `end_date`,`rs`.`visit_info_id` AS `visit_info_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`patient_name` AS `patient_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`assigned_staff_id` AS `assigned_staff_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`assigned_staff_name` AS `assigned_staff_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`companion_id` AS `companion_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`companion_name` AS `companion_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`service_code_id` AS `service_code_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`service_code` AS `service_code`,`rs`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`rs`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at` from ((((`buddy`.`recurring_schedules` `rs` join `buddy`.`schedule_types` `st` on((`st`.`id` = `rs`.`schedule_type_id`))) join `buddy`.`users` `u` on((`u`.`id` = `rs`.`staff_id`))) join `buddy`.`recurring_rules` `rr` on((`rr`.`id` = `rs`.`recurring_rule_id`))) left join `buddy`.`visit_info_details` `vid` on((`buddy`.`vid`.`id` = `rs`.`visit_info_id`))))

tables.name: schedule_details
tables.comment: 一覧の読み出しに使う、予定と訪問の情報と名前を結合したビュー
tables.def: CREATE VIEW schedule_details AS (select `s`.`id` AS `id`,`s`.`facility_id` AS `facility_id`,`s`.`schedule_type_id` AS `schedule_type_id`,`st`.`name` AS `schedule_type_name`,`s`.`date` AS `date`,`s`.`start_time` AS `start_time`,`s`.`end_time` AS `end_time`,`s`.`is_over_time_work` AS `is_over_time_work`,`s`.`staff_id` AS `staff_id`,`u`.`username` AS `staff_name`,`s`.`title` AS `title`,`s`.`description` AS `description`,`s`.`recurring_schedule_id` AS `recurring_schedule_id`,`s`.`visit_info_id` AS `visit_info_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`patient_name` AS `patient_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`assigned_staff_id` AS `assigned_staff_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`assigned_staff_name` AS `assigned_staff_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`companion_id` AS `companion_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`companion_name` AS `companion_name`,`buddy`.`vid`.`service_code_id` AS `service_code_id`,`buddy`.`vid`.`service_code` AS `service_code`,`c`.`id` AS `cancel_id`,`c`.`reason` AS `cancel_reason`,`s`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`s`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at` from ((((`buddy`.`schedules` `s` join `buddy`.`schedule_types` `st` on((`st`.`id` = `s`.`schedule_type_id`))) join `buddy`.`users` `u` on((`u`.`id` = `s`.`staff_id`))) left join `buddy`.`visit_info_details` `vid` on((`buddy`.`vid`.`id` = `s`.`visit_info_id`))) left join `buddy`.`schedule_cancels` `c` on((`c`.`schedule_id` = `s`.`id`))))

tables.name: visit_infos
tables.def:
CREATE TABLE `visit_infos` (
  `id` char(26) NOT NULL,
  `patient_id` char(26) NOT NULL,
  `assigned_staff_id` char(26) NOT NULL,
  `companion_id` char(26) DEFAULT NULL,
  `service_code_id` char(26) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_visit_infos_patient` (`patient_id`),
  KEY `fk_visit_infos_assigned_staff` (`assigned_staff_id`),
  KEY `fk_visit_infos_companion` (`companion_id`),
  KEY `fk_visit_infos_service_code` (`service_code_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_visit_infos_assigned_staff` FOREIGN KEY (`assigned_staff_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_visit_infos_companion` FOREIGN KEY (`companion_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_visit_infos_patient` FOREIGN KEY (`patient_id`) REFERENCES `patients` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_visit_infos_service_code` FOREIGN KEY (`service_code_id`) REFERENCES `service_codes` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
